versions.content: Relation of swRecordLayoutGroup to subElement For each swRecordLayoutGroup an appropriate subElement shall be created. The algorithm shall be recursively applied to the newly created Implementation- DataTypeElement s. As the record layout groups are nested, this recursion yields the complete structure in the ImplementationDataType .
